content.title: América vs Cruz Azul line-ups – Clausura 2026
content.text: America Y Ya·12 April 2026América vs Cruz Azul line-ups – Clausura 2026América will face Cruz Azul in the Matchday 14 clash of the Clausura 2026.Las Águilas come into this match aiming to reclaim sixth place in the overall standings and solidify their spot in the playoff zone with a win over Cruz Azul.OneFootball VideosAmérica’s lineup: Rodolfo Cota, Sebastián Cáceres, Israel Reyes, Ramón Juárez, Cristian Borja, Jonathan dos Santos, Rodrigo Dourado, Vinícius Lima, Brian Rodríguez, Alejandro Zendejas, and Patricio Salas.On the bench will be: Fernando Tapia, Kevin Álvarez, Miguel Vázquez, Isaías Violante, Alan Cervantes, Alexis Gutiérrez, Thiago Espinosa, Raphael Veiga, Erick Sánchez, and José Zúñiga.Cruz Azul’s starting 11:The match will kick off at 09:00 PM and will be broadcast on Canal 5, TUDN, VIX Premium, and Layvtime. In the United States, it will air on TUDN USA.This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence.
